sections.title: Sound of letter э
paragraphs: The letter (э) /ɛ/ sounds like (это) /ˈɛtə/, which means this, that. This letter is a vowel. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. This letter has two different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, keep your mouth open halfway. Spread your lips slightly. Push your tongue forward in your mouth. Voice is on. For the second sound, raise your tongue higher and move it slightly back. Keep your lips relaxed. Place your fingers on your throat to feel the strong buzz of your voice.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In a stressed syllable, say the vowel like in (это) /ˈɛtə/ or in (поэт) /pɐˈɛt/. A stressed syllable is said with more strength. In an unstressed syllable, say the shorter vowel heard in (этаж) /ɪˈtaʂ/ or in (экран) /ɪˈkran/. An unstressed syllable is said with less strength.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not add a glide before this vowel. English words like yes begin with a quick consonant sound. Keep the start clean and plain, like the vowel in the English word bet. Do not slide into another sound at the end. Hold the vowel steady until the sound stops completely.
